root_cause: The tab component incorrectly maps the ArrowDown and ArrowUp keys to horizontal navigation (next/previous tab) in addition to ArrowRight and ArrowLeft, causing the down arrow to switch tabs instead of preserving focus on the current tab.
repair_strategy: Restrict tab keyboard navigation to only horizontal arrows (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and their aliases) for switching tabs, ignoring vertical arrows (ArrowUp/ArrowDown) to prevent unintended tab changes.

edits.before:
/**
   * Handle tab keydown event
   *
   * - Press right/down arrow for next tab
   * - Press left/up arrow for previous tab
   *
   * @private
   * @param {KeyboardEvent} event - Keydown event
   */
  onTabKeydown(event) {
    switch (event.key) {
      // 'Left', 'Right', 'Up' and 'Down' required for Edge 16 support.
      case 'ArrowLeft':
      case 'ArrowUp':
      case 'Left':
      case 'Up':
        this.activatePreviousTab()
        event.preventDefault()
        break
      case 'ArrowRight':
      case 'ArrowDown':
      case 'Right':
      case 'Down':
        this.activateNextTab()
        event.preventDefault()
        break
    }
  }
edits.after:
/**
   * Handle tab keydown event
   *
   * - Press right arrow for next tab
   * - Press left arrow for previous tab
   *
   * @private
   * @param {KeyboardEvent} event - Keydown event
   */
  onTabKeydown(event) {
    switch (event.key) {
      case 'ArrowLeft':
      case 'Left':
        this.activatePreviousTab()
        event.preventDefault()
        break
      case 'ArrowRight':
      case 'Right':
        this.activateNextTab()
        event.preventDefault()
        break
    }
  }

expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing the down arrow key while focused on a tab will no longer change the selected tab, allowing users to use vertical arrow keys for scrolling within the tab panel without triggering unintended navigation.
functional_risks: If the tab list is rendered vertically (not the case in this implementation), vertical arrow navigation would be broken. However, the observed DOM and CSS confirm a horizontal tab layout.

Removing vertical arrow handling may affect users who expect vertical movement in a vertical tab list, but the component is used horizontally here and the ARIA APG specifies horizontal arrow keys for horizontal tablists.
verification_requirements: Confirm left/right arrow keys still switch focus between adjacent tabs.
Confirm up/down arrow keys do not change the focused tab or selected tab state.
Confirm the tab panel associated with the focused tab remains visible when using vertical arrow keys.
